# JÖR Water

> JÖR (pronounced "Jor") is a premium packaged drinking water brand from India. It is treated and mineral-balanced with salts of calcium, magnesium and potassium for a crisp, clean taste, and sealed fresh in a diamond-cut bottle. Brand line: "Ask for Jör, Unlock more."

## Product
- JÖR Premium Drinking Water, 250 ml bottle
- Ingredients: treated water, salts of calcium, magnesium and potassium
- Tamper-evident cap; batch number and packing date printed on every cap and neck
- Best before six months from packing date

## Who it is for
- Hotels, restaurants, cafés, offices and event organisers who want a premium water for their guests, plus everyday drinkers
